reason: A file-handling interface plugin for DeepSeek Harness that supports dragging or pasting files into chat, represents them as references and cards, and supplies paths or workspace copies for agent access.

summaries.zh: 将文件拖入或粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框，并以引用气泡和文件卡片形式随消息发送。
summaries.en: Drag or paste files into the DeepSeek Harness chat composer and send them as reference bubbles and file cards.

capabilities: Intercepts file drag-and-drop and clipboard paste in the chat composer
Reads or obtains absolute paths for dropped files in the desktop environment
Persists pasted binaries or fallback text copies under the session workspace
Provides a dropped_files tool for listing unsent dropped files
